methods.scope: Six selected quantitative variables, SEX and cognitive-status categories; no search across all MRI measures.
methods.missing: Available working values per variable; unusable values counted explicitly, no global deletion or new imputation.
methods.sd: Sample standard deviation, denominator n-1; undefined for n<2.
methods.quantiles: Linear/inclusive type 7, h=(n-1)p; singleton quantile equals its sole value.
methods.group_comparison: Four NACCUDSD groups within main_pair; same participants for MoCA and MRI, variable-specific availability for covariates.
methods.percentages: Both population and available-value denominators stored; unavailable category has no percent_of_available.
methods.outliers: 1.5 IQR review on all_shared usable values; strict outside-fence comparisons; no removal.
methods.precision: Full numeric precision in JSON/CSV; display only rounded, mm to 3 and other summary measurements to 2 decimal places.
methods.weights: Unweighted descriptions of the supplied subset; no population weights supplied.
methods.sensitivity: Descriptive summaries of integer-score inclusion scenario only; no effect, CI, test or model comparison.
